definitions.gloss: kick the can (a children's outdoor game)
definitions.explanation: A traditional children's outdoor game combining hide-and-seek and tag. An empty can is placed in the open; the player who is "it" guards it while finding the others, but anyone can free the captured players by kicking the can before being caught.

examples.japanese: {公園|こうえん}で{缶|かん}{蹴|け}りをした。
examples.english: We played kick the can in the park.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のころ、よく{友|とも}だちと{缶|かん}{蹴|け}りをして{遊|あそ}んだ。
examples.english: When I was a kid, I often played kick the can with my friends.

examples.japanese: {鬼|おに}が{気|き}づかないうちに{缶|かん}を{蹴|け}れば、{捕|つか}まったみんなを{助|たす}けられる。
examples.english: If you kick the can before the "it" notices, you can free everyone who's been caught.

notes:
A traditional outdoor children's game, a variant of hide-and-seek in which an empty can serves as the home base. Kicking the can resets the round and rescues captured players.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {缶|かん}{蹴|け}りをする: to play kick the can
- {缶|かん}{蹴|け}りで{遊|あそ}ぶ: to play (around) at kick the can

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鬼|おに}ごっこ: tag — the basic chasing game; {缶|かん}{蹴|け}り adds a can and a hiding element
- かくれんぼ: hide-and-seek — {缶|かん}{蹴|け}り combines this with tag
